community_list_entries.name: Good Memory Has ECC: Evaluating the Memory of Vision-Language Models Beyond Accuracy

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces ECCBench, a benchmark/protocol measuring memory efficiency (FLOPs), compression and calibration in streaming recall. It uses synthetic integer/letter streams and natural video (EPIC-Kitchens-100, SoccerNet), evaluating VLMs and from-scratch backbones (Mamba-2, RetNet, TTT-MLP, ...). Memor
